Food ok, service charmless and inattentive
Feb 2025 • Couples
The decor is pleasant, the menu comprehensive, and the food we chose was well cooked and presented but... The staff were young, somewhat inattentive, and disinterested in guiding us through the extensive menu. Consequently I think we missed out on the most interesting dishes. The staff, huddled around the pay desk, appeared oblivious of the fact that our ordered drinks had not arrived and never ventured out to see whether customers were happy.
Food service was mechanical, quality was good, flavours surprisingly underwhelming and the bill much as expected. 
The Old Hanoi may be resting on its laurels, but it really needs a shakeup on the service front.

Good food and service
Jan 2025 • Family
My wife and I plus adult son ate here on our last night in Hanoi. Very close to Train Street. Wasn’t particularly busy. Extensive Vietnamese menu. Service was good and pleasant ambience. We had a selection of starters/mains - good sized portions, fresh and tasty food and no complaints from anyone. Slightly pricier than some restaurants but good meal so worth it. Dessert menu a little disappointing so we skipped dessert here.

The Viet food here is legit. Perfect experience from start to end.
